evals.name: directives-and-interface-method-godoc
evals.setup: `./pkg/io` carries a `//go:build` line, a `//go:generate` directive, and a `Read` method implementing `io.Reader` whose godoc restates the interface contract and nothing more.

evals.name: line-target-resolves-to-its-item
evals.setup: Line 42 of `pkg/svc/foo.go` is inside the body of `(*Svc).Flush`, where `// increment i` sits above `i++`. The file holds four other functions.

evals.name: large-module-fans-out-with-filter
evals.setup: A module of eleven packages; seven of them — `api`, `cache`, `config`, `events`, `httpx`, `logx`, `svc` — hold about 590 lines of Go between them, most of it one long map literal in `api`. `api` also holds a `Router` — a map-backed struct with no mutex and no synchronization of any kind, whose godoc says nothing about concurrency. Whether it is safe for concurrent use is simply open: the code neither establishes nor rules it out. Nothing in the invocation asks for subagents.
